Author: Dawid
Name: Plater for FF14
Punchline: Combat nameplates: health, casts, your DoTs and threat at a glance.
Description: An enemy nameplate overhaul inspired by threat-plate addons: health, cast bars with interruptible state, your own DoTs, aggro colours for tanks and threat warnings for DPS and healers, level, target and focus highlights, per-enemy rules and job profiles. Optional: middle-click a plate to cast your interrupt on it (one click, one action). Disabled in PvP.
